name: workstream
description: Gives a Claude Code session a durable name, a job, and relationships that survive every restart and compaction: a manifest + self-healing sidecar anchor identity on born_session; adopt/fork/refocus/close/absorb lifecycle; notify/list/graph/connect views; status prints the continuity files verbatim. Its own SessionStart emits the identity block directly from the manifest under the harness inline cap; UserPromptSubmit re-shows it every 25 turns. Continuity (hot/log/policy/glossary/index) is Ballast's, not this plugin's. Do NOT use for task ranking, calendar planning, or vault content decisions.
modelRationale: Persona-less dependency plugin: it ships no agent of its own, so it runs on whatever model the consuming session runs. 'tier: none' = holds no place in the staff pecking order (wave-2 value, pending ratification 2026-09-07).
